report.faults: API substitutions for picker/disk/quota; actual storage events and native downloads

report.cache: native Web Locks + actual second tab/storage events; fault substitutions for quota/picker/render

report.customerPdfCheck: Actual downloaded PDF structure and metadata; existing full PDF suite retains layout and text checks

methodology.scope: Historical phase90 app capture and original retained parser compared with actual production semantic binding.42 synthetic compatibility states plus27 operational states, including original UI adoption of a formal fixture.
methodology.budget: Unchanged original depth32/300000nodes at the canonical retained root; complete reconstructed capture uses original128MiB guard. Compound exact128MiB cases are separate unit evidence.
methodology.javascript: 14 unsupported JavaScript states remain negative. Legacy getter/toJSON calls measured; new prototype calls neither.
methodology.protection: Production reading integrated; observation itself grants no application authority. Historical v0.1 and v0.2 evidence retained.
methodology.limits: This matrix tests capture only. Full application/native evidence is recorded separately. No full-input equivalence,4/8 capacity,timing or peak-memory claim.

initial_failed_probe.scope: Initial all-six-source-save setup copied large source texts across CDP. Kept as failed observation; final baseline uses in-browser hashes and the original phase92 pre-check save state. Separate all-six-saved replay subsequently passed with the same production runtime.

initial_native_failure.reason: The first full suite reused synthetic caches from8-row pressure tests. Only the dedicated synthetic profile was reset before the complete rerun; original limits and test assertions were unchanged.

methodology: All46 original native suites and69 capture compatibility/operational states rerun on the new offline product. Baseline guidance uses original1/4/8fixtures,2 pre-check saves and6 post-check saves per case; source hashes are computed in-browser and compared with exact adopted inputs. Separate8-row replay saves all6 sources before checking,12 saves total; only count/save-order and report assertions differ in the local derived driver. File inputs/save inspection retain documented API substitutes; no physical disk or real-phone claim. Absolute local metadata is redacted from published reports; original reports remain local. All original test/source/tool files are fingerprinted; historical reports and measurements remain unchanged. The validation process was interrupted after45 completed suites; the final unchanged post-application-requote script was resumed in the dedicated environment and appended only after success.
